02-internet-fundamentals.md.title: Internet Fundamentals
02-internet-fundamentals.md.description: Module 05 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 2 --- The Internet is a global network of millions of computers connected together across the world. It allows people to share information, communicate, and access services from anywhere. Simple Definition: The Internet is a worldwide network of networks — it connects LANs, MANs, and WANs all over the world into one giant network.
